meta.title: Viavo: AI voice assistant for CarPlay, in 29 languages
meta.description: Press one button and say it your way. Viavo opens routes with a stop, calls, messages, plays music and radio, and answers out loud. 29 languages, a native voice in each.
meta.ogTitle: Say it in your language. Viavo gets it done.

stepItems: Download it from the App Store on your iPhone.

One button. Say it the way you’d say it to a person.
faqItems: How is Viavo different from ChatGPT or Gemini in CarPlay?

ChatGPT and Gemini in CarPlay are built for conversation. Viavo also acts on what you say: it calls a contact, also in WhatsApp, reads new WhatsApp and SMS messages and replies by voice (on iOS 27), plays music or a radio station, and from one sentence opens a route with a stop, or a place along the way, in your navigator.
Which languages does Viavo speak?

29: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Dutch, English, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese. In each one, the app’s screens and a native voice, a woman’s or a man’s.
Does it replace Siri?
No. Viavo is its own app on your CarPlay screen: open it and press one button.
Is it safe to use while driving?
Viavo is made for eyes on the road: one big button, answers out loud, and nothing on the car screen asks you to look at your phone.
Do I need to learn commands?
No. Press one button and say it the way you’d say it to a person.
Does it work without CarPlay?
Yes, on iPhone: the same one button, and you can also type.
Which apps does it work with?

Apple Maps, Google Maps and Waze; Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and Apple Podcasts; Simple Radio, TuneIn and iHeartRadio; WhatsApp, Viber, SMS, Telegram and Slack; Gmail, iCloud and Yahoo mail; HomeKit, Calendar and Reminders. It also opens other apps by name.
How much does it cost?

Try Viavo for free: a new account starts with free credits or a free week of Viavo Plus, on the monthly or the yearly plan (one free week per person). If you cancel during the free week, access ends right away. Prices are in the App Store, in your currency.
How does WhatsApp work with Viavo?

On iOS 27 or later, through the one Viavo automation that Viavo’s Settings set up step by step. Viavo reads new WhatsApp and SMS messages aloud and sends your reply after you confirm the person and the text. On WhatsApp it replies to people who wrote to you after you connected; an SMS can go to anyone in your contacts. “Call Anna on WhatsApp” starts the call, from the car screen too. On earlier iOS versions the message opens ready on your phone, and you tap Send.
What happens to my data?
It’s all in two documents.

whatsapp.title: How does WhatsApp work with Viavo?
whatsapp.availability: Works on iOS 27 or later, through the one Viavo automation. On earlier iOS versions, a message opens ready on your phone and you tap Send.
whatsapp.receive: Viavo reads aloud new WhatsApp and SMS messages that arrive after you connect: the sender and the notification’s preview text, not past chats or attachments. SMS with one-time codes and messages from short numbers are skipped.
whatsapp.send: A reply goes out only after you confirm the person and the text. On WhatsApp, Viavo replies to people who have written to you since you connected; an SMS can go to anyone in your contacts, and the phone fills in the number itself. “Call Anna on WhatsApp” starts a WhatsApp call to anyone saved in your contacts, from the car screen too.
whatsapp.setup: While parked, open Viavo’s Settings and follow the steps: install the Viavo shortcut, turn on its automation and run the check. The same automation covers WhatsApp, SMS, calls in WhatsApp and Viber, and opens Viavo when CarPlay connects.
